messages:
elaine (support): :rotating_light: Heads up — multiple customers (prod) reporting 5xx and timeouts starting ~09:12 PST. Error rate on /v1/generate up ~32% and p95 latency spiking. Customers: Acme, Brightly, Cedar.
raj (oncall): looking. Is this limited to a region or global? any recent deploys?

elaine (support): appears EU and US ingress both affected. No related deploys in the last hour from the deploy log. Alerts show gateway 502/504 + ‘upstream timeout’ from inference-proxy.

tomas (sre): pulling logs now. Initial guess: connection pool exhaustion or backend saturation. Can someone start a quick mitigation plan: 1) enable fallback cluster routing 2) increase gateway replicas 3) throttle heavy clients.

matt (runtime): FYI backend ML nodes show increased queue depth and some OOM restarts on older quantized pods. Rolling up the runtime metrics now.

raj (oncall): will scale gateway to 12 replicas and enable soft-fail to smaller model variants for hosted tier. kubectl command: `kubectl scale deploy/hg-api -n hosted --replicas=12` — I'll run that.
support-bot: scaling initiated by raj (oncall) — progress events in channel.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback not detected in last 60m. No active rollouts.

elaine (support): customers asking for workaround — suggested: lower concurrency and use retry with jitter on client side. Shared sample snippet to support teams.

raj (oncall): scaled gateway to 12, enabling traffic split to fallback models (smaller-1/10 of traffic). Applying routing policy: `route: fallback_percent=10` — done. Observe for 2m and widen if success.

tomas (sre): observing drop in 5xx from 32% -> 18% after routing change, p95 still elevated. Runtime team, can you drain OOMing pods and bump node pool?

matt (runtime): draining bad runtime pods now, triggering warmup for new instances. Also toggling KV cache aggressive warming for hot prefixes.

elaine (support): customer comms: notified Acme + Brightly that we have mitigations in place and we'll follow up with RCA.

raj (oncall): short-term mitigation checklist complete. Next: 1) capacity increase request to infra (node pool + autoscaler tweak) 2) postmortem / action items list 3) contact billing if any client retries billed unexpectedly.

elaine (support): noted. I'll open support tickets and tag customers. Also capturing repro steps from their SDK logs — sending payload snippet to #incidents-attachments.

tomas (sre): quick triage notes for postmortem: - root symptom: backend queue overflow + a subset of older quantized pods OOMing under sustained larger-batch requests - contributing: autoscaler thresholds too conservative for sudden fanout + routing policy didn't shed heavy clients early - mitigation success: fallback routing + gateway replica scale + draining pods reduced error rate.

raj (oncall): action items (assign): - increase autoscaler max and node pool margin (raj) - improve circuit-breaker to shed heavy clients earlier (tomas) - add proactive KV-cache warmup on scale-up (matt) - customer comms + billing check (elaine) - write playbook for similar spikes (elaine + tomas)

elaine (support): assigning now. Will create follow-up thread for postmortem doc and invite customers to scheduled post-incident call.

matt (runtime): adding runtime metric dashboards and an alert for OOM restarts per-minute in the runtime cluster.

raj (oncall): closing immediate war room. If 5xx creeps back up, re-open this thread. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: War room marked resolved by raj (oncall). Creating incident ticket INC-2023-3098765432 for postmortem and action tracking.

elaine (support): follow-up: will post timeline + evidence in docs/incident-runs and ping PMs. Thanks all. :pray:
